# Radiant Vista

> Radiant Vista is a business hotel on Gokul Road in Hubballi, Karnataka, close to Hubballi Airport, with three room types, the Brick and Brew restaurant, the Breeze Point rooftop bar and the Gala Vista banquet halls.

## Key facts
- Name: Radiant Vista (business hotel)
- Address: Plot No 04, S/No 106A, 107B, 108A & 109A, Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi, Karnataka 580030, India
- City: Hubballi (also spelled Hubli), Hubballi-Dharwad, Karnataka
- Front desk phone: +91 836 200 2487 (24 hours)
- Reservations and WhatsApp: +91 91871 95517 (https://wa.me/919187195517)
- Second front desk line: +91 836 451 1339
- Email: reservations@hotelradiantvista.com
- Website: https://hotelradiantvista.com/
- Book online: https://bookings.resavenue.com/engine-ibe/search?regCode=TXRX0322

- Check-out time: confirmed at booking

A designer room with individually controlled air conditioning, a 42-inch Smart TV, a hot water kettle, a work desk and high-speed Wi-Fi.
- Amenities: Individually controlled AC, 42" Smart TV, Hot water kettle, High-speed Wi-Fi, Work desk, CCTV-secured premises

## Dining: Brick and Brew (restaurant)
In-house restaurant serving nostalgic Indian favourites with a modern twist (butter chicken, gourmet momos, home-style dal), with retro Bollywood music. Open to hotel guests and visitors.
- Cuisine: Indian
- Opening hours: please confirm with the hotel
- Reservations: WhatsApp +91 91871 95517
- Page: https://hotelradiantvista.com/dining/

## Rooftop bar: Breeze Point
Open-roof rooftop bar and restaurant with curated cocktails, savoury bites and views over the city. Separate areas for quiet dinners and groups.
- Opening hours: please confirm with the hotel
- Alcohol: served; legal drinking age in Karnataka is 21
- Page: https://hotelradiantvista.com/bar/

- Hubballi Airport: short drive (exact distance on request)

## Nearby places
- Inorbit Mall Hubballi: The city's main mall for shopping, dining and family entertainment, a short drive from the hotel.
- Hubballi Airport: The domestic airport sits on the same Gokul Road corridor as the hotel, which makes airport transfers easy.
- Hubballi Junction: The main railway station of the South Western Railway zone, with trains to Bengaluru, Mumbai, Goa and beyond.
- Unkal Lake: A 110-year-old lake with parkland, boating and a large statue of Swami Vivekananda. Popular at sunset.
- Chandramouleshwara Temple: An 11th-century Western Chalukya temple known for its detailed black stone carvings.
- Nrupatunga Betta: A hilltop viewpoint with wide views over Hubballi-Dharwad, best visited at sunrise or sunset.
- Siddharoodha Math: A historic spiritual centre and ashram dedicated to Sri Siddharoodha Swami, visited by devotees from across the region.
- Indira Gandhi Glass House Garden: A public garden with a glass house modelled on London's Crystal Palace. It hosts the city's flower shows.
